essence: The deity is surrounded by learned sages led by Śuka holding radiant books.
The lord is encompassed by Brahmāṇī, Padmanābha, and Ānanda.
The lord is worshipped in the east by Mīmāṃsā and Dharmaśāstra.
The lord is worshipped in the north by Sāṅkhya and Pātañjala.
The lord is encircled by the thirty-three gods beginning with Indra.
